Four Family Members Die of Electrocution in Maharashtra's Satara

Four members of the same family died from electrocution in Satara, Maharashtra, during heavy rains. The incident occurred when a man touched a live wire, and his wife, son, and daughter were electrocuted while attempting to save him. A preliminary investigation suggests a snapped cable became live after touching an overhead power line.
